reports.title: Ligand Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Ligand is raising its 2026 full year adjusted earnings per diluted share guidance and reaffirming its 2026 revenue guidance. Ligand now expects the following:
•Adjusted earnings per diluted share2 of approximately $9.50 to $9.75, raised from approximately $9.00 to $9.50
